description: Create OWC Design System resource dictionary and completely rewrite OperatorWindow.xaml with the new command center layout implementing all B1-B10 features from the design spec.
steps: Create WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Themes/OwcDesignSystem.xaml resource dictionary with all design tokens: colors (#0F1117 Background, #1A1D27 Panel, #252A36 Surface, #00D4FF Electric Cyan accent, #FF3366 Live, #00E676 Connected, #FFAB00 Warning, #F0F2F5 Text Primary, #8B92A5 Text Secondary, #4A5068 Text Muted, #2A2E3A Border), button styles (rounded 8px corners, hover effects), panel styles (corner radius 8-10px), and typography (Segoe UI font family).

Completely rewrite WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Views/OperatorWindow.xaml with the new layout structure: (1) TOP ROW - Live preview hero boxes (Audience left with #FF3366 LIVE glow border, Stage right with #00E676 CONNECTED indicator), (2) HEADER BAR - OWC logo text, search placeholder (Ctrl+K), Tools dropdown, account icon, settings gear, (3) LEFT SIDEBAR - slim collapsible service order with group headers, icons per item type, active item highlighted with #00D4FF cyan accent left border, + Add button at bottom, (4) CENTER - slide grid using WrapPanel in ScrollViewer with thumbnail tiles showing background + text preview + section label + slide number, active slide with glowing cyan border, click to fire live, (5) BOTTOM-RIGHT of grid area - Zoom slider controlling thumbnail size, (6) TOP-RIGHT of grid area - Edit mode toggle button, (7) TRANSPORT BAR at very bottom - large Prev/Next buttons, BLACK button, LOGO button, CHORDS toggle, slide counter text, current song/section info, (8) RIGHT SECTION of transport bar - backtrack status (song title, section, position, key, tempo).

Ensure the XAML uses proper Grid layout with RowDefinitions and ColumnDefinitions. The Window should be Background=#0F1117, FontFamily=Segoe UI, with merged resource dictionary pointing to the OwcDesignSystem.xaml. Use x:Name attributes matching the code-behind field names that will be needed.

Include all named elements that the code-behind references: ServiceOrderList (ListBox), CurrentItemTitle, CurrentItemSubtitle, SlideCounterText, CurrentSlidePreview, NextSlidePreview, SlideThumbnailsPanel (WrapPanel for slide grid), LiveButton, ChordsToggleBtn, BacktrackStatusText, BacktrackSongText, BacktrackSectionText, KeyInfoText, CapoInfoText, TempoInfoText, PitchInfoText, ConnectedDevicesCount, NdiStatusText, NdiStatusDot, NdiToggleButton, NdiToggleStatusText, ThemeSelector, ChordToggleCheckBox, NotesBox, ZoomSlider.

The live preview hero boxes should use large Border elements with 16:9 aspect ratio containers, dark backgrounds, centered text previews showing current slide content. The Audience box gets a pink/magenta glow effect (outer border or drop shadow) when live. The Stage box gets a small green dot indicator with CONNECTED text.

The slide grid thumbnails should be generated programmatically (WrapPanel named SlideThumbnailsPanel), but include a placeholder empty state message. The zoom slider should be a WPF Slider control at the bottom-right corner of the grid area.

Transport bar should be a fixed-height panel at the very bottom spanning full width with: left section (current item info), center (navigation buttons), right section (display controls + backtrack info). Buttons should use the design system styles with rounded corners and appropriate accent colors.
acceptance_criteria: WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Themes/OwcDesignSystem.xaml exists with all OWC design colors, brush resources, and button/panel styles
OperatorWindow.xaml is completely rewritten with the new command center layout
Layout has: hero preview boxes at top, header bar, left sidebar, center slide grid, transport bar at bottom
All color values match the OWC Design Identity spec exactly
All x:Name elements needed by the code-behind are present in the XAML
The XAML is valid WPF targeting net8.0-windows (no UWP or WinUI syntax)
OwcDesignSystem.xaml is properly referenced as a merged resource dictionary in OperatorWindow.xaml
verification: Confirm all existing tests still pass
findings: Build and all 233 tests pass. SectionName is on Slide object, not SlideContent. VerticalAlignment needed full qualification (System.Windows.VerticalAlignment) due to ambiguity with the using statements. Review fix: button hover trigger changed from OwcSurfaceBrush to new OwcSurfaceHoverBrush (#2F3544) for visible feedback.
